title: Mental Fortitude
subtitle: Stoic discipline, willpower, and self-mastery
lede: A reference to {videos} sources on stoic philosophy, willpower, and mental discipline.
about_paragraphs: A reference built from {videos} videos applying stoic philosophy to willpower, focus, self-discipline, and emotional control — synthesised into {library_files} knowledge files and {glossary_terms} glossary terms.

Every claim traces to a specific point in a specific source — a page, a paragraph, or a video timestamp, depending on what kind of source made the claim. Nothing here is generated: there is no model in this app, and it makes no network requests. It works offline, permanently.
catalog_description: Every video ingested into this knowledge package, with the subjects, themes, practices, and concepts each one covers.
